faq.question: Which Python version do these programs need?
faq.answer: They were run on Python 3.12. Any Python 3.8 or newer will run them, but the "Did you mean" hint in the NameError example and the ~~~^~~~ error markers only appear in recent versions.

faq.question: Why does my output look different from the article?
faq.answer: Check for small differences in the code first, especially numbers and indentation. Program 7 only matches exactly if you keep the random.seed(42) line. Program 1 depends on what you type at the prompts.

faq.question: Why does Python say it can't concatenate str and int?
faq.answer: input() always returns text, even when you type digits. Convert it before doing maths, for example age = int(input("Age: ")).

faq.question: Where is the CSV file saved in program 10?
faq.answer: In whatever folder your terminal was in when you ran the program. Open that folder and expenses.csv will be there; it opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
